description:
We are a team of five enthusiastic and creative students: Huda, Atifa, Manaswitha, Yoshitha, and Harshitha. We are passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. Our team brings skills in research, creativity, problem-solving, presentation, and teamwork, with an interest in exploring AI and technology to develop innovative solutions.

We are looking for team members with skills in coding, web development, data analysis, AI/ML, and space science who are passionate about learning..
